draft.emotion: a quiet, hollow feeling of being by yourself, reflective and slightly melancholic
notes: 'Samotny' usually implies sadness (lonely) or being unattached/single (e.g., 'samotna matka' — single mother).
To simply say you are physically alone in a place without a sad implication, use 'sam' instead (e.g., 'Jestem sam w domu' — I am home alone).
